import html # The base HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ Safe Page

User Input

{user_content}

""" def build_html_page(client_input: str) -> str: """ Construct a safe HTML page by escaping the user-provided input before inserting it into the template. Parameters: client_input (str): Raw content provided by the user. Returns: str: A complete HTML page with the escaped user input embedded. """ # Escape special characters to prevent XSS and other injection attacks safe_content = html.escape(client_input, quote=True) # Format the template with the escaped content return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
